newsitem.title: USA: Crystal cannot account for stock swings.
newsitem.headline: Crystal cannot account for stock swings.

text.p: Crystal Broadcasting Inc said Friday it was unaware of any negative developments within the normal course of its business activities that would account for the recent decrease in the per-share price of its common stock.
The recent volatile movements in the price of Crystal Broadcasting's common shares are believed to be the result of trading activities within the securities markets, the company said.

President Joseph Newman said in a statement said the company "continues to make significant strides towards consolidating our position in the radio broadcasting marketplace, specifically in the area comprising the Florida panhandle."
He said the company was actively seeking to selectively acquire additional radio stations.
Crystal owns and operates WLUS-AM in Gainesville, Fla.
